name: @phonedek/desktop
description: PhoneDeck desktop configurator and action host
author: Pelozo

scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.pack:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win dir --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run build:mac-helper && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:signed: npm run build && npm run build:mac-helper && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never --config electron-builder.signed.yml
scripts.dist:mac:universal: npm run build && MAC_HELPER_ARCH=universal npm run build:mac-helper && electron-builder --mac --universal --publish never
scripts.pack:mac: npm run build && npm run build:mac-helper && electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 --publish never
